question: Should OpenClaw core add per-agent backup/restore/clone now, and what credential/session portability policy should that first-party workflow enforce?
rationale: The requested CLI flags are feasible in core, but the correct restore contract affects credentials, private transcripts, SQLite state, config rewrites, and the broader backup format, which requires maintainer product and security intent before implementation.

options.title: Sponsor a scoped core design
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical per-agent tracker and implement a guarded `--agent`/`--as` flow only after defining archive contents, secret handling, transcript policy, rollback, and compatibility tests.

options.title: Fold into broader backup work
options.body: Make the broader backup/restore effort own per-agent restore semantics and close this only after that work explicitly covers the `--agent` and clone contract.

options.title: Defer first-party clone support
options.body: Leave users on documented manual migration for now and revisit once backup restore and transcript safety are more mature.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a scoped core design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical per-agent tracker and implement a guarded `--agent`/`--as` flow only after defining archive contents, secret handling, transcript policy, rollback, and compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent backup-area coverage and current main history make this the best available owner for routing the cross-cutting product/security decision.
